name: Martin McKeay
biography: is the host and author of the Network Security Blog and Podcast. He is a well known expert in the field of PCI and has worked as a QSA for over four years; he's seen the security compliance can encourage, as well as the lengths people will go to in order to avoid implementing real security. He is an advocate for PCI and compliance while recognizing it's limitation, a dichotomy that sometimes threatens his sanity.
